snippet.title: Serious Sam: Shatterverse Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067210/Serious_Sam_Shatterverse/

A new gameplay trailer for Serious Sam Shatterverse provided a chaotic glimpse at this roguelite shooter set in the Serious Sam universe, where you play as a crew of multiversal heroes. It's coming to PC & consoles on August 31, 2026.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
